definitions.explanation: Broadcasting an event live as it happens, especially sports, news, or ceremonies. Also used for relay transmission of signals.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}を{生|なま}{中継|ちゅうけい}で{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched the game on a live broadcast.

examples.japanese: {現場|げんば}から{中継|ちゅうけい}でお{伝|つた}えします。
examples.english: We're reporting live from the scene.

examples.japanese: {開会式|かいかいしき}の{模様|もよう}は{全国|ぜんこく}に{衛星|えいせい}{中継|ちゅうけい}された。
examples.english: The opening ceremony was broadcast nationwide via satellite.

notes:
{中継|ちゅうけい} means relay or live broadcast — transmitting an event as it happens. Combines {中|ちゅう} (middle, relay) + {継|けい} (continue, relay).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|なま}{中継|ちゅうけい} (live broadcast — the most common compound)
- {衛星|えいせい}{中継|ちゅうけい} (satellite broadcast)
- {現場|げんば}{中継|ちゅうけい} (on-site broadcast)
- テレビ{中継|ちゅうけい} (TV broadcast)
- ネット{中継|ちゅうけい} (online live stream)
- {中継|ちゅうけい}{地点|ちてん} (relay point)

USAGE:
Most often used for broadcasting: {現場|げんば}から{中継|ちゅうけい}でお{伝|つた}えします (reporting live from the scene) is a standard news phrase. Also used as a する verb: {試合|しあい}を{中継|ちゅうけい}する (broadcast a game live).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {放送|ほうそう}: broadcast (general term, not necessarily live)
- {配信|はいしん}: distribution, streaming (especially online)
- {中継|ちゅうけい} specifically emphasizes live, real-time transmission
